Through Hi  Maternal Uncle Shahid Hussain S/o Sh. Munshi Khan Man  o Mandphiya, Chittorgarh.

----P  Versus  1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  2. Prahlad Singh S/o Sh. Jawan Singh, R/o Karo  Mandphiya, Chittorgarh (Raj.).
 
 For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Satish Kumar Shar  Sangwa  For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/05/2023

The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the FIR No.156/2022 registered at Police Station Mandaphiya, District Chittorgarh for offences under Sections 376, 511, 354(d) & 384 of IPC and Section 67 of IT Act.

Learned Public Prosecutor submitted a report received from the SHO, Police Station Mandaphiya,
District Chittorgarh wherein it has been mentioned that after investigation challan of the case has already been presented.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
Stay petition also stands disposed of.
